title: corunastylis littoralis
intro: Corunastylis littoralis, commonly known as the Greenhood Orchid, is a species of terrestrial orchid native to eastern Australia. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Corunastylis littoralis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being studied, but they are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
